MY SHAPE STUDIO

My Artwork Story

Look at your finished collage and tell the story behind your choices.

Look, then try.

Describe one detail you can point to in your picture. Explain why you chose a colour or shape. A grown-up can type your spoken words. There is no single correct story or best-looking picture.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Create with a grown-up. An adult helps with cutting. Use child-safe glue, keep small scraps out of mouths and keep devices away from glue.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

What are we learning?

Talking about artwork builds vocabulary, reflection and confidence in explaining choices.
